dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region to the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Presence of a minor asymmetrical indentation on the right lateral margin near the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median pixel value across the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density distribution of fine dark-pixel clusters (speckling) across the cranial and mid-dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp gradient boundaries between the dark speckles and the depigmented white base.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Numerous small, discrete dark-pigmented marks scattered across the visible dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct V-shaped notch located on the posterior segment of the dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast dark aperture (blowhole) positioned on the midline of the cranial region.
